verdict.rationale: The registry offers one documented bulk write operation, a 'Mass change registered agent' form, but it is a PDF rather than a programmatic interface. Bulk read access to business-entity data exists through the keyless Socrata open-data API on data.colorado.gov (probe returned HTTP 200 JSON) and through data requests. There is no evidence of bulk filing, renewal, or other multi-item operations an AI-native user could automate. Missing for 10: programmatic bulk filing or periodic-report endpoints, bulk operations beyond registered-agent changes, documentation of mass-change scope and limits, hands-on corroboration of bulk write workflows.
